title: GPT-2-style TinyStories model

paper.title: Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners

related.title: TinyStories: How Small Can Language Models Be and Still Speak Coherent English?

paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement GPT-2-style TinyStories model: train a causal decoder on a documented TinyStories subset within a provisional ten-minute run. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use tinystories; required output: [N,T] token IDs -> [N,T,V] logits. Evaluate bpc (minimize). Provisional ten-minute training run; tokenizer and split must be declared. Required ablation: Remove learned position embeddings with the token budget unchanged. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.
